author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
What does it take to move in a big machining tool into Adam's workshop? After cutting his teeth with the Shenwai lathe he's had in his shop for over a decade, Adam brings in a new precision lathe to level up his skills. This beautiful Monarch lathe finds its new home next to Adam's pantograph mill, and Adam starts disassembling its parts to clean and personalize. 

Clickspring's video about the world's first precision lathe: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4pK3O43Jddg

Shot by Adam Savage and edited by Norman Chan
Music by Jinglepunks
